findings: Reliability and strategic usefulness missed the frozen thresholds; do not promote Gemini to live selection.
The temporary-cost probe selected the immediate coin-scoring deterministic candidate rather than any candidate carrying the rubric's declared short-term cost.
The preserve-future-option probe mentioned route-destruction risk but selected c01, which removes 32 terrain cells, instead of minimum-damage c04, which removes one.
The invalid response carried usage but the retained artifact intentionally contains no rejected provider payload, so its exact schema or semantic violation cannot be reconstructed.
The artifact omits provider diagnostics for provider_error results and therefore cannot distinguish HTTP availability, rate limit, network or abort failures.
The runner passes preparation as zero after constructing fixtures, so its p95 measures provider and validation time rather than the complete live decision window.
